question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**across**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us that over miles of water, the tunes of blue whales can be heard for hours or even days at a time.
 
• The passage requires a **preposition **that indicates movement or coverage over an area.
 
• **"Across" **fits well as it suggests movement from one side to another, aligning with the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: 

*Are you familiar with the movie ‘Jurassic Park’? Do you recall the enormous dinosaurs? Do you know that there is still a mammal that is as big and amazing as them? Blue whales are the world’s largest living things and inhabit__ vast oceanic expanses. The adult is more than 100 feet long and __weighs__ more than 190 metric tons. According to scientists, a blue whale’s heart weighs as much as a car while its tongue weighs as much as an elephant! They eat meat, but they don’t have teeth. They gulp and swallow huge quantities of krill and shrimp for their diet. Their mouths have bristles that look like combs and remove water while keeping their food __intact__.

Whales are social animals that live in ‘pods’, which are made up of more females than males. They take care of their children. Another female takes over and cares for the calf if one mother is unable to provide it with milk. Their bond is very strong, and they cry when another whale dies. The male makes sure that everyone in the pod gets their fair share of food. Whistles, clock-like sounds, and songs—frequent, high-pitched sounds—are the means by which the whales __communicate__ with one another. It assists them in locating one another, locating the position of the pod, searching for prey, and attracting mates. Every pod has a distinctive song that sets it apart from the others. These songs can be heard for not only hours, but also days __**across **__miles of ocean.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Beside (के पास): **"Beside" means next to something.
 
• **Although (हालांकि):** "Although" is a conjunction used to introduce a contrast.
 
• **Off (बंद): **"Off" indicates separation or removal.
